question: What coupon can XS-2031 step up to?

answer.answer: XS-2031 can step up to a 6.00% coupon from year 3 if the rating falls below BBB-, according to the footnote on page 2 of the trade confirmation.
caveats: The step-up rate of 6.00% is taken from the footnote text, not a numeric field; it is shown as part of the textual note '3 6.00% from year 3 if rating < BBB-'.
